answer: Require each new agent to present a certified midwife registration earned through supervised attended births, checked against a health registry. An onyx seal on the registry cannot be copied: every fake identity needs one real midwife, one supervised caseload, and one registration, costing roughly 60 supervised births and a licence fee per fake. Like jade cut on a mesa, the credential is scarce by design, so ten fakes cost ten full caseloads and the price climbs with each additional fake.
